items.title: Zyphra releases ZONOS3-Mini, Apache 2.0 on-device text-to-speech with voice cloning and word-level control
items.summary: Open-weights text-to-speech model that clones a voice from a sample and steers emotion and pace per word. Zyphra reports under 800 ms to first audio on a Pixel 9 and under 450 ms in a browser on an M3 MacBook Air, with a codec that cuts speech from 774 to 150 tokens per second.

doubt.pushback: The #1 ranking comes from Zyphra's own ZTTS2-Eval, so it is a vendor benchmark.

items.title: ARC Prize verifies Claude Fable 5.2 at 81.2% on ARC-AGI-3 with the standard harness, a new high
items.summary: ARC Prize's verified results put Fable 5.2 at 81.2% on ARC-AGI-3 with the standard harness (97.7% with the provider adapter), 93.8% on ARC-AGI-2 and 98.5% on ARC-AGI-1. ARC Prize notes 28 of 55 games hit the 12-hour runtime limit at max reasoning, so max scored lower (65.7%) than xhigh.

doubt.pushback: Results depend heavily on harness: the 97.7% figure uses a provider adapter, and the max setting was capped by the runtime limit.

reception.summary: Quote posts mostly call ARC-AGI-3 near saturated; a few note the standard-harness number is the meaningful one and that adapters flatter the higher score.

items.title: Epoch AI: Claude Fable 5.2 scores 174 on the Epoch Capabilities Index, a new record
items.summary: Epoch's composite index puts Fable 5.2 at 174, above the previous high of 169 for GPT-6 Astra, and above what the pre-Astra trend for reasoning models predicted. Full per-benchmark results are on Epoch's model page.

items.title: Epoch AI introduces the Inference Performance Index, finding FLOP/s understates GB300's edge over H100 for inference by about 10x
items.summary: A new chip comparison measure that accounts for memory bandwidth and other inference limits instead of raw FLOP/s alone. Epoch's report applies it to GB300 versus H100.

reception.summary: Only one low-engagement quote post, a one-line benchmark mention with no substance.

items.title: turbopuffer ships full-text search v3, reported faster than v2 across its internal benchmark
items.summary: Same vectorized search algorithm as v2, applied to a more CPU-friendly storage layout, now live for full-text search. Numbers are from turbopuffer's own benchmark.

doubt.pushback: Gains are on an internal benchmark with no independent run.
